notes: No summited track exists for this peak in the packet, so nothing is assigned. The East Face route's Summit pin (48.55186,-120.59014) is 168 m south of Peakbagger's surveyed coordinate (48.553355,-120.590487) while the other two routes' pins are 18 m from it; there are no recorded high points to adjudicate (rule needs tracks and Peakbagger to agree within 100 m), so no move is proposed. The 2015 report says the base was reached without snow in mid-September, which conflicts with the stored 'snow persists year-round' line; one low-snow year, so no change proposed.
